scope: Every records.jsonl row; no target-pattern, ASR, static, or LLM preselection.
safety: Commands, eval, network requests, and unsafe YAML construction are intercepted before side effects.
method: Execute both a minimal untrusted-input driver and a bundled-test input variant. Any confirmed source-to-sink path is retained; otherwise the direct-input result is primary. Combine runtime evidence with an explicit task-level source trust model.
